policies.n: French ordinary passports: visa not required for a visit of up to three calendar months. Passport must have at least three months validity on entry. Months are not converted to 90 days.

Individual Serbian visitors require a visa from a Tunisian mission before travel. An organised tourist group may instead receive a visa on arrival with a prepaid hotel voucher and confirmed return air ticket matching the stay. Group participation is not assumed. No initial stay is conclusively specified; the page’s three-month extension discussion is not used as the initial allowance.
policies.label: Advance visa; organised-group arrival exception

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary-passport holders require a visa; BOCA identifies the Tunisian Embassy in Tokyo as an application mission. Stay unspecified. This establishes the visa requirement, not that any electronic channel is unavailable.

HISTORICAL ONLY: Berlin embassy capture of 12 December 2023 expressly names this nationality (or EU membership excluding Cyprus) as visa-exempt. This is not live confirmation of the 2026 rule. The page gives a general three-calendar-month tourist ceiling, but nationality-specific duration differences are not independently reconciled; d=0 intentionally.
policies.label: Historical visa waiver — 2023 evidence

policies.n: HISTORICAL ONLY: 12 December 2023 Berlin capture provides a visa waiver when entering as part of a package tour; otherwise its explicit visa-procedure default applies. Package-tour participation is not assumed. Current implementation and stay duration are not verified.
policies.label: Historical package-tour waiver; visa otherwise

policies.n: HISTORICAL ONLY: 12 December 2023 Berlin capture explicitly subjects third-country nationals not in its two exemption lists to visa procedures. Recorded only as archived evidence, not a current 2026 visa-required determination. Stay and current electronic-method eligibility are unknown.
policies.label: Historical visa requirement — 2023 evidence

policies.n: Ordinary Indian passport visa waiver suspended from 22 November 2025. Visa required for entry or transit. BOCA reports a general requirement for foreign visa applicants to use a registered Iranian agency and agency-arranged itinerary. This is a requirement-only rule: current final eVisa, arrival and consular eligibility remain unverified, and no claim that eVisa is unavailable is made.
policies.label: Visa required; final issuance method unconfirmed

policies.n: Australian ordinary-passport holders must obtain a visa before travel. BOCA reports a general requirement for foreign visa applicants to use a registered Iranian agency and agency-arranged itinerary. Final electronic-versus-consular issuance is not settled; no consular-only inference or numerical stay. Israeli stamps/visas can cause refusal.
policies.label: Advance visa; final issuance method unconfirmed

policies.n: German ordinary-passport visitors require a visa and may apply for an online eVisa before entry; carry the electronic visa printout. Stay is unspecified here. Reliable operation of visa on arrival is not established. BOCA also reports a rule for all foreign visa applicants requiring a registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary; independent direct application is not assumed.

French ordinary passports: private short visits may obtain a 30-day visa at certain Iranian airports only after online preregistration, carrying its printed confirmation. The source does not enumerate eligible airports, so this is not an all-port entitlement. BOCA reports that all foreign visa applicants must use a registered Iranian travel agency and an agency-arranged itinerary; retain that condition as well. Mission application in advance is recommended and requires in-person fingerprints. No walk-up/no-preapproval entitlement is asserted.
policies.label: Airport visa; agency and preregistration required

policies.n: Malaysian national passports: visa-exempt for stays not exceeding 30 days; longer stays or other purposes require a visa. Origin-government evidence applies only to Malaysians.

Taiwan ordinary-passport visitors need an Iranian registered travel agency to apply and arrange their itinerary. Prior online application is followed by physical visa issuance at the selected mission or Iranian international airport; carry printed approval/application documents. Airport fee payable in euro cash. Tourist stay is at most 90 days, but actual grant controls. This is not a direct final eVisa or unrestricted walk-up arrival visa.
policies.label: Pre-approved visa; Iranian agency required

policies.n: HISTORICAL ONLY: Hong Kong consulate snapshot of 13 November 2025 records an ordinary-passport tourism waiver from 4 February 2024, one entry every six months, maximum 15 days, nonextendible. Other purposes and longer stays require visas. This is not current live verification. India is expressly excluded from these additions because a later official withdrawal is verified.
policies.label: Historical tourist waiver — November 2025 evidence

policies.n: Serbian ordinary passports require a visa. Serbia MFA and the live no-third-country-status tourist checker reject direct eVisa/arrival eligibility; the static Kuwait nationality list still includes Serbia. Preserve the common visa requirement with acquisition-channel uncertainty pending consular reconciliation. No stay duration is established.
policies.label: Visa required; channel conflict

policies.n: Chinese ordinary passports: published tourist guidance describes a visa requirement, but direct eVisa/arrival eligibility conflicts with the current no-third-country-status checker, which returns false for both, and the runtime arrival list. Requirement retained; precise application channel and duration remain unconfirmed. Do not infer an entry ban or universal electronic-visa unavailability from this branch.
policies.label: Visa required; channel conflict

policies.n: Ordinary visitors are expressly named in the Eswatini Tourism Authority and Kuala Lumpur High Commission visa-exempt schedules. Duration is not conclusively specified: the mission’s 60-day residence-permit threshold and visa validity periods are not initial visitor stay grants. Palestine means the explicitly named Occupied Palestinian Territory ordinary passport, not any other refugee/travel document.

Visa required under the explicit non-listed-nationality defaults in the Tourism Authority and Kuala Lumpur High Commission schedules, after retaining identified conflicts separately. Obtain permission in advance through an Eswatini mission; tourism authority says direct government issuance on arrival is not yet available. Electronic issuance eligibility and initial stay duration are not established; visa-validity fees do not set a stay.
policies.label: Advance visa required; stay unspecified

policies.n: Tourist visa exemption expressly stated by Malaysia’s Santiago mission. Source says usual stay is less than 30 days, not an inclusive 30-day maximum. Complete MDAC within three days before arrival.

Ordinary-passport tourism/social visit exemption expressly confirmed for this nationality. The stated initial period is not a visa validity or extension. MDAC is a separate arrival declaration; no permission to work or settle is implied.

Singaporean ordinary-passport visitors require advance eVisa through Togo Voyage, at least five working days before arrival. Initial stay unspecified by this source. Passport six months valid on expected departure.

Taiwan passport holders apply for Togo eVisa/entry approval at least five working days before arrival. Present Ministry-issued approval and supporting documents at the border; border completion is not a separate unrestricted VOA alternative. Initial stay unspecified.

Ordinary visitors fall under Togo Voyage’s explicit foreign-national visa default; they are not in the inspected ordinary exemption schedule. Visa applications are normally online in advance; these nationalities are omitted from the published electronic-eligibility enumeration, so individual electronic processing eligibility remains uncertain. No inference of visa unavailability or entry refusal. Stay unspecified.
policies.label: Visa required; electronic eligibility unconfirmed

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary-passport tourists must apply online for Uganda eVisa before travel and carry emailed approval. No walk-up arrival visa. The separate East Africa Tourist Visa’s 90-day validity is not copied onto the ordinary Uganda tourist stay.

Taiwan ordinary-passport tourists require prior permission. Either obtain a visa at an Uzbek mission, or obtain an agency/company invitation approved and stamped by Uzbek MFA, with visa permission number, before travel for issuance only at Tashkent airport. Passport valid at least six months, return/onward ticket, photos required. This is a pre-cleared visa, not unrestricted VOA; stay depends on grant.
policies.label: Advance visa or pre-cleared Tashkent issuance

policies.n: Vietnam ordinary passports: tourism waiver up to30 days for travellers who have reached55. Under16: accompanied by legal representative and holding a biometric travel document, waiver for accompanying person’s visa validity, at most90 days. Other travellers need a visa under the express default. Vietnam is now expressly in the joint eVisa/simplified-consular list, but this disjunctive heading does not prove a specific issuance method; neither age nor accompanying status is assumed.
policies.label: Age-conditioned waiver; visa otherwise

policies.n: Taiwan ordinary-passport holders must obtain a Serbian visa in advance from a Serbian mission. BOCA expressly says EU/US visas or residence permits do not substitute for the Serbian visa for these passports. Duration and electronic delivery eligibility unconfirmed; no eVisa-unavailable claim.
